name: Avalonia
description_en: Develop Desktop, Embedded, Mobile and WebAssembly apps with C# and XAML. The future of .NET UI
readme_excerpt: 📖 About Avalonia is a cross-platform UI framework for dotnet, providing a flexible styling system and supporting a wide range of platforms such as Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android and WebAssembly. Avalonia is mature and production ready and is used by companies, including Schneider Electric, Unity, JetBrains and GitHub.
